fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) has surged 89.2% over five years, significantly outpacing NXP Semiconductors (NXPI)'s 34.5% rise, driven primarily by valuation expansion (from 24.2x in 2021 to higher current levels).
fields.summary_ko.1: NXP delivered excellent profitability with 124.7% EPS growth over the same period, but stock price gains were limited as the P/E multiple investors pay declined from 33.1x to 20.9x.
